independent.summary: `searchEntities` sends no `?limit=`, so every keystroke-word triggers an unbounded `GET /entities?q=` that serializes every matching row in the workspace in one response — the exact unpaged full-workspace read KOL-067 removed from the initial load (`LIST_LIMIT_MAX`'s own comment: "an unbounded JSON.stringify of one workspace's entire row set is time nobody else's request can run in"), now reachable from the search box: typing a single common letter matches nearly every entity, on the single event loop every tenant shares.

While a search is active the sidebar reads `searchResults`, which no mutation path updates, so create/edit/delete no longer reach the list: `removeEntity` filters `entities` only, leaving the deleted row listed and clickable, and `selectEntity(id)` is called un-awaited and uncaught in WikiLayout, so clicking it rejects on a 404 with the stale detail panel left in place; `editEntity` likewise leaves the old title on screen until the box is cleared.

`markBlockOnlyMatches` compares rows against the full term the client sent, but the server caps the term at `MAX_TERM_LENGTH` (200) in `searchTerm`, so for a longer term the needle is not what was matched and no row's title/summary can contain it — every returned row is falsely labelled "matched in text".
